compilerCompatibilityRepair.implementation: Replace the single logical-assignment expression with equivalent ordinary assignment and push. Preserve the registered-handler, WeakMap, lifecycle, authorization and mutation contracts.
compilerCompatibilityRepair.previousValidationGap: Earlier native harnesses used a modern Babel version and did not verify compatibility with the deployed compiler.
compilerCompatibilityRepair.saveGate: All CALS JavaScript resources must compile with the reviewed compiler digest before UpdateWeAppContentByAppId. Missing or mismatched compiler and any compilation failure reject the save.
